title: unified-rollouts: add coordinated shadow + A/B + canary controller with automated multi-metric rollback
author: Elena Morales
description: Motivation: unify canary, A/B and shadow traffic flows under a single controller so rollout policies (weights, shadowing, thresholds, hysteresis) are coordinated and automated rollbacks can act across all traffic types. This PR implements a unified rollout controller, multi-metric rollback evaluation, and an opt-in shadow traffic handler for staging and prod. Checklist: - Implement controller that orchestrates weighted canaries, A/B variants, and shadow paths - Add metric-matching engine to evaluate multiple signals (latency p50/p95, error-rate, token-quality delta) - Support hysteresis and cooldown windows to avoid flapping - Add observability: rollout metrics, traces, and dashboard templates - Add e2e tests (integration + canary failure simulation) - Add migration/upgrade script and docs - Add feature flag default-off for private deployments Summary of changes: This PR introduces a new rollouts controller package with the core orchestration logic, extends the rollout API to accept shadow and experiment configuration, wires observability hooks, and adds end-to-end tests that simulate canary failures and validate autorollback behavior. The rollout controller evaluates metrics emitted by inference pods, computes weighted health, and triggers automatic rollback when configured thresholds are violated across one or more configured metrics. The controller supports: - Weighted canaries with gradual ramp steps - A/B experiments with percent splits and variant pinning - Shadow traffic (copy-only) for validating variants without affecting user-visible traffic - Multi-metric thresholds with per-metric tolerance and aggregate policies - Hysteresis windows and cooldowns to avoid transient rollbacks Rollout plan: staged merge to main, feature-flag gated in config for initial rollout, enable on staging for 24h with synthetic traffic, enable on prod for low-traffic customers first. Migration notes: existing rollout CRDs are backward compatible; a small schema bump allows optional shadow/experiment blocks. Operators should run scripts/upgrade-rollout.sh to populate defaults for existing rollouts. Testing: unit tests for strategy logic, integration tests for metric evaluation, and e2e test harness added (e2e/tests/rollouts-canary.spec.ts) that injects faults and verifies rollback path. Related: ENG-9821 (rollout consolidation), ENG-9903 (autorollback multi-metric), SUP-412 (customer reported inconsistent canary behavior).

release_notes: Adds a unified rollout controller that coordinates canary, A/B experiments, and shadow traffic. Introduces automated multi-metric rollback with hysteresis and cooldowns. Includes observability metrics, dashboard templates, e2e tests, and migration tooling. Default-off feature flag for private installs.
notes_for_ops: Run scripts/upgrade-rollout.sh after deploy to populate any missing defaults. Feature gated by deploy/helm/values-rollouts.yaml:unifiedRollouts.enabled=false by default. Monitor rollout_controller.rollout_status and rollout_controller.rollback_count for the first 48 hours.
